en: Colorized historic street scene showing Großhartmannsdorferstraße in Brand-Erbisdorf, a small town with two- and three-story buildings with steep roofs. People stand and sit along the roadside, and a horse-drawn carriage moves down the street. In the distance a church tower rises above trees and rooftops. German text captions identifying the town and street are printed at the top, and a large German shop sign is visible on the left building.
